decision: 10 second time penalty. 2 penalty points (total of 5 for the 12 month period).
fact: Forcing another driver off of the track
offence: Alleged breach / Breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 b) of the International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video, timing and in-car video evidence. STR was defending his position against GAS between T12 and T13 going off line to the right of the straight, then changed direction to the left without leaving a car width space for GAS. As a result GAS was forced off at T 13.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 18 Forcing Another Driver Off Of The Track
to: The Team Manager, Aston Martin Aramco F1 Team
